title: AgentSpacePolicy
description: Oversight policy (spec v0.1, DECISIONS D-045). Says which tools run freely, which need a person's approval and which are blocked. Semantics: within one policy, the strictest matching rule wins, and the default applies only when no rule matches; across policies (code and collector), the strictest result wins. Findings can only make a result stricter. Conformance cases: examples/policy.cases.json.

default.description: Action for tools no rule matches. Default: allow.

on_findings.description: What the collector does when a detector finding arrives.

pause.description: Detector ids whose findings pause the run, or "*" for any.

min_severity.description: Only findings at least this severe pause. Default: warning.

match.description: Tool name glob: * is any run of characters, ? is one character. Case-sensitive, whole name.

agents.description: Only these agent ids. Omitted: every agent.

on_findings.description: The action once the run has a detector finding (only ever stricter: a laxer value is ignored).

show_arguments.description: Review: show the call's arguments (after redaction) to the person approving. Default: true.

reason.description: Shown to the person approving, and to the model when the call is blocked.
